title: Freeze the Existing Technical Baseline

evidence_classes.primary: Local downloaded artifacts, computed digests, generated configuration copies, installer outputs, runtime logs, archives, and host discovery collected 2026-09-01.
evidence_classes.reconstructed: Earlier handoff claims and historic reports are comparison context only and are not used as acceptance evidence.
evidence_classes.provisional: The zero-mod control is the safe reversible baseline while Item 3 determines the eventual retained stack.
evidence_classes.untested: No real client join, production hardware test, or candidate-mod compatibility test is represented by this Item 2 control.
evidence_classes.missing: No load-bearing Item 2 evidence is missing. Client join, candidate compatibility, worldgen correctness, and performance remain explicitly outside this zero-mod baseline gate.
